message.reasoning_content: We need to determine crimes based on facts. The scenario: Defendant Li entered an elderly man's house, climbed wall, entered room, assaulted (choked, gagged, threatened), victim called for help, Li fled. This is illegal intrusion (burglary) and assault causing bodily harm? The acts: illegal entry into dwelling (非法侵入住宅罪) and assault (故意伤害罪) maybe. Chinese criminal law: Article 245 (非法侵入住宅罪) for entering another's residence without permission, causing disturbance. Also assault (故意伤害罪) if causing injury. Here he choked, gagged, threatened. Did he cause injury? Possibly minor injuries. Could be "非法侵入住宅罪" and "故意伤害罪". Also could be "抢劫未遂"? No theft. So list both crimes separated by semicolon. According to correction rules: list statutory offense name without appending “罪”. So we should output "非法侵入住宅;故意伤害". Ensure no "罪". Format: [罪名]非法侵入住宅;故意伤害<eoa>. Provide JSON with reasoning and final_answer.
